requirements.text: Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
Strong hands-on Android development experience with Kotlin, Android SDK, and modern architecture patterns (e.g., MVVM/Clean Architecture).
Experience building UI using Jetpack Compose and/or XML, including accessibility and responsive layout practices.
Experience with mobile testing practices and frameworks (unit + instrumentation/UI tests) and troubleshooting complex issues.
Experience implementing/improving CI/CD for mobile (automated builds, quality gates, release processes).
Disciplined experience using AI coding assistants (Claude AI or equivalent where approved) with verification and secure usage practices.
Experience with modularization, shared libraries, and scaling Android codebases across teams.
Experience with performance profiling and stability tooling (startup time, memory, crash analytics, ANR monitoring).
Familiarity with mobile security best practices (OWASP MASVS awareness, secure networking, secrets handling, certificate pinning where applicable).
Experience with release strategies (feature flags, phased rollouts) and operational readiness (runbooks, monitoring).
Experience mentoring engineers and improving delivery metrics (cycle time, defect escape, app stability).
